## Section Materials

Section meets **Fridays, 9:30AM-10:20AM, in the Ogg Room (North Hall 422)**. Each meeting typically begins with questions and review, and the remainder is devoted to short, guided exercises that implement the week's material in {{< fa brands r-project >}}.

Section materials are distributed as `.qmd` files along with their rendered `.html` form. You are welcome to follow along in the rendered handout, but you will get more out of section by opening the `.qmd` and running the code yourself. Any supporting files (e.g. datasets) are located in sub-folders of the week's directory.

Section exercises are not graded and are not submitted -- they are there to build the practical computing skills the problem sets and the replication project assume.

Links become active as the materials for each week are posted.
